title: SlowFallingTNT
body:
# SlowFallingTNT
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Makes TNT fall slowly by settings its velocity to 0    
- The purpose of this plugin is to prevent players from using TNT catapults or flying machines but also to make TNT less predictable.  
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
